mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID, PW_HASH, USER_NM, HP_NO, EMAIL, ORG_NM, DEPT_NM, TEL_NO, ROLE_DVCD, STTUS_DVCD, LTLY_LOGIN_DT, LOGIN_FAILURE_TMCNT FROM DXAPI_USR_USER_M WHERE USER_ID = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE DXAPI_USR_USER_M SET LTLY_LOGIN_DT = SYSTIMESTAMP, LOGIN_FAILURE_TMCNT = 0, MODDT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE USER_ID = #{id}
UPDATE DXAPI_USR_USER_M SET LOGIN_FAILURE_TMCNT = LOGIN_FAILURE_TMCNT + 1, MODDT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE USER_ID = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT USER_ID, PW_HASH, USER_NM, HP_NO, EMAIL, ORG_NM, DEPT_NM, TEL_NO, ROLE_DVCD, STTUS_DVCD, LTLY_LOGIN_DT, LOGIN_FAILURE_TMCNT FROM DXAPI_USR_USER_M
AND STTUS_DVCD = #{status}
AND ( LOWER(USER_ID) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{q}) || '%' OR LOWER(USER_NM) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{q}) || '%' OR LOWER(EMAIL) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{q}) || '%' OR LOWER(DEPT_NM) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{q}) || '%' )
ORDER BY USER_ID
